serialPortTerminal.hotPlugEnabled.descri: Enable hot-plug detection (periodic polling of serial devices).
serialPortTerminal.logDirectory.descript: Directory for saved logs. Leave empty to use the default (Documents/SerialPortTerminal/Log).
serialPortTerminal.logFilenameTemplate.d: Template for log filenames. Placeholders: {device} (device name), {YYYY} year, {MM} month, {DD} day, {HH} hour, {mm} minute, {ss} second.
serialPortTerminal.logFilenameTemplate.p: Filename cannot contain any of these characters: \ / : * ? " < > |
serialPortTerminal.logTimestampEnabled.d: Prepend a timestamp to each line of the saved log.
serialPortTerminal.logTimestampFormat.de: Timestamp format. Placeholders: {YYYY} year, {MM} month, {DD} day, {HH} hour, {mm} minute, {ss} second, {SSS} millisecond.
serialPortTerminal.logMaxFileSize.descri: Maximum size of a single log file in KB. Set to 0 to disable splitting; when set to 1 or more, oversized logs are split into numbered files (e.g. "..._002.log").
serialPortTerminal.logShortcutsEnabled.d: Enable the Ctrl+S shortcut in the serial terminal to start/stop log recording. WARNING: when enabled, Ctrl+S is intercepted by the extension and is NOT sent to the device.
serialPortTerminal.agentBridge.host.desc: Listening address for Agent Bridge. Default is localhost only (127.0.0.1).
serialPortTerminal.agentBridge.ports.des: Candidate ports for Agent Bridge. When starting, a picker lets you choose one (a single value is used directly).
serialPortTerminal.baudRates.description: Baud rates offered in the manual configuration picker (positive integers).
serialPortTerminal.frameFormats.descript: Frame formats (data bits-parity-stop bits) offered in the manual configuration picker, e.g. "8-N-1".
